cause.what_happened: Today's -15.6% (gap -9.2%, intraday -7.1%, 3.25x volume) is the second session of giving back a promotional spike. findings.finding: An effective resale registration for Ascent Partners' equity line (333-295364) is open and can be drawn on 2026-09-29. It covers 150.6m ELOC purchase shares before the 1:25 and 1:4 splits, about 1.5m after them, against 605,647 shares outstanding. It prices at 97% of the lowest 10-day VWAP and has been drawn before ($13.1m of $100m used). The company had $719k of cash at 06-30 and going-concern language.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The line is live and the issuer has used it: the 10-Q shows $86.9m of capacity remaining, and the DEF 14A calls the ELOC 'important to our ability to obtain sufficient working capital'. A purchase notice can be delivered on any trading day, including 2026-09-29, and Ascent resells into the tape under the effective prospectus. So supply lands inside the window without any announcement.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No dated ELOC draw can be isolated in the baseline. The line has been in place through the whole 60-day -83% run and through chains of consecutive falls (08-19 -50.6% then -44.2% then -27.9% then -16.1%; 09-25 -28.1% then today -15.6%), which fits persistent supply but does not prove it.
findings.why_not_priced: The close prices what has been sold so far, not a draw priced at 97% of a 10-day low VWAP that now includes today's print. After a spike the company has an incentive to raise while volume is elevated. If the price held that supply, the fall would have stopped on thinning volume rather than extending 09-25's -28% on 3.25x volume.
findings.independence: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1859807/000121390026051331/ea0288960-424b3_profusa.htm is the 424B3 of 2026-05-04 registering 179,272,293 shares for resale (pre-split), 150,568,827 of them ELOC purchase shares. It is the same issuer but a different document from the 10-Q.
